name: WATERFALL
considered: A grid of small cells, each lit by a band of the spectrum with a fixed random threshold (a lit fraction proportional to the level, three brightness steps): SPECTROGRAM scrolls the rows down (frequency across, time down, scrolled by the draw engine's copy through the stash) and ZONES keeps the grid still, each cell owned by one band scattered over the box (a heat map). A Player 2 test of the pack framework: the drawing code exists only in its pack (meter_pack_waterfall_grid.c); the firmware carries a stub that says so.

params.label: Scroll speed
params.note: milliseconds per row of the spectrogram

params.label: Gain
params.note: how bright the grid is for a given level

params.label: Cell size
params.note: the cell is this many pixels square, with one pixel between cells
